note.name: Hyperliquid
note.horizonLabel: over the next 8 weeks, into the 6 Nov unlock
note.thesis: Fees annualise at $1.02B and revenue at $802M, and the 7-day fee pace exceeds the 30-day. But HYPE trades at 111x annualised revenue against a 31x peer median, with 410M future emissions and 238M contributor tokens outstanding.
note.what: Hyperliquid is a Layer 1 blockchain whose main application is a fully on-chain order-book exchange for perpetual futures and spot. Users trade perps, stake HYPE to secure the network for fee discounts and pay gas on HyperEVM. The core users are professional market makers, prop traders and whales needing low latency and no gas on HyperCore.

points.text: 30-day fees $83.81M, annualised $1.02B; 7-day fees $21.04M, annualised $1.10B, running above the 30-day rate. Revenue 30-day $65.95M, annualised $802.40M.
24-hour perp volume was $15.93B on 30 Oct. A SEC filing puts Hyperliquid at about 9.4% of global perp volume and 63% of decentralised perp open interest in 2026.
FDV to annualised fees 85.1x and to annualised revenue 111.3x, against a peer median of 10.9x fees and 30.8x revenue.
390.6M unlocked of 390.7M scheduled; next 90 days add only 25,691 validator-reward tokens and no cliffs. The Assistance Fund bought about $1.7M of HYPE a day in the 7 days to 22 Oct.
410M future-emissions tokens and 238M contributor tokens remain outside circulating supply. The 7 Oct batch was 3,750,000 HYPE, about $342M, reported as an OTC sale to one institutional buyer.

note.supplyText: CoinGecko shows 239.4M circulating and 951.5M total. On-chain reads on 22 Oct show 998,836,744 total, 302,030,132 circulating, a 410,563,426 future-emissions reserve and 238,057,560 with the contributor address. DefiLlama's schedule has 390.6M of 390.7M unlocked, no cliffs, and only validator rewards ahead.
note.valuationText: Revenue is the better anchor for HYPE: HIP-3 deployers may keep up to half the fees on their own markets, so gross fees overstate what the protocol keeps. FDV to annualised revenue is 111.3x against a 30.8x peer median; FDV to annualised fees is 85.1x against 10.9x.
note.usageText: Fees were $83.81M over 30 days, annualised $1.02B, and $21.04M over 7 days, annualised $1.10B. Daily perp volume was $15.93B on 30 Oct. Staking rewards run about 2.37% a year at 400M HYPE staked, funded from the future-emissions reserve.

catalysts.text: First validator-reward tokens under DefiLlama's emissions schedule
CoinGecko lists a next unlock of about 0.92M HYPE

risks.title: Multiple is expensive
risks.text: 111.3x annualised revenue against a 30.8x peer median leaves little room if growth slows.

risks.title: Supply overhang persists
risks.text: 410M future-emissions and 238M contributor tokens, with monthly contributor transfers the pattern since Nov 2025.

risks.title: Fees are volatile
risks.text: The buyback depends on fees; weakening fee pace would undercut the case. Cause of any slowdown not identified.

risks.title: Deal approvals may slip
risks.text: The ICE and trade[XYZ] onshore plan is subject to approvals, so the main bull trigger may not land on schedule.

watchlist.item: ICE/trade[XYZ] onshore US perps awaiting CFTC approvals
Three whale wallets sent 494,310 HYPE to Coinbase

note.positioningText: Funding is positive at +0.0100%/8h versus a 7-day average of +0.0136%/8h, so longs pay shorts. Open interest across exchanges is $429M, up 33.3% over 7 days. The long/short account ratio is 1.08, with 52% of accounts long. Crowding is mild but open interest is expanding.
note.conclusion: Fees run above the 30-day pace and the buyback is real, but HYPE trades at 111x annualised revenue against a 31x peer median with 410M future-emissions and 238M contributor tokens outstanding. At 3.2%/day realised volatility the 8-week range is $72 to $116. Evidence does not justify a directional view before the unlock or the approvals settle.
note.invalidation: Nov 6 unlock above 3.75M HYPE, or 7-day annualised fees below the 30-day pace for two weeks.
note.gaps: No primary next-90-day contributor unlock calendar was found, only press reports and CoinGecko estimates. Aggregator supply figures disagree. A Q3 share claim of 38.6% of on-chain perp volume conflicts with the SEC filing's 9.4% global perp volume and 63% decentralised open interest.
